## Step-by-Step Description:

### 1. Create the Main Body
- Create a box with dimensions 200×100×100 (length × width × height)
- Position it at the origin (0, 0, 0)

### 2. Create the Windshield Cutout
- Create a smaller box with dimensions 50×100×50
- Position it at the top front edge of the main body
- The cutout should be at coordinates (75, 0, 25) - this places it at the front-right corner of the top surface
- Use a boolean difference operation to subtract this box from the main body

### 3. Create the Wheels
- Create 4 cylinders, each with radius 25 and thickness 10
- Orient them so their axis is parallel to the width (Y-axis) of the car
- Position them at the four bottom corners of the body, but embedded halfway into the body so only semicircular protrusions are visible

### 4. Wheel Positioning Details:
- Front-left wheel: at (-75, -45, -50) 
- Front-right wheel: at (-75, 45, -50)
- Rear-left wheel: at (75, -45, -50)
- Rear-right wheel: at (75, 45, -50)

### 5. Combine All Parts
- Use boolean union to merge the wheels with the body (after the windshield subtraction)
- This will create the final toy car model with integrated wheel protrusions

The final result will be a toy car with a rectangular body, an angled windshield cutout at the front top, and four wheels that appear as semicircular bumps protruding from the bottom of the car body.
